recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Future cleanup could remove stale XML comments or generated-placeholder narrative in adjacent profile source if a broader editorial cleanup is approved, but FHIR-11014 itself is already applied in the current build scope.
issue_request: FHIR-11014 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for the DSTU2 FamilyHistory area asking to add a genetics pedigree example. The resolution said to improve the examples by replacing visible todo text, correcting v3 RoleCode usage, and completing the pedigree tree.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 214db1d0b45d4e107d4a12241b50446f50971948, which changed source/list/list-example-familyhistory-genetics-profile.xml for #11014 by removing the active To do narrative, adding parent-reference display text, and changing the relatives/relationships to a complete simple pedigree. Later commit d1f387ce5e71114e7369ac9dd345022ded36edd0 updated the example from the old hl7.org/fhir/v3 RoleCode URL to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-RoleCode.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory and List are both active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The genetics example is listed in source/list/list-List-examples.xml and linked from source/familymemberhistory/familymemberhistory-examples-header.xml. FHIR-11139 separately changed the FamilyMemberHistory scope text to link to the genetic profile rather than the example, and FHIR-11138 added a separate double-cousin pedigree example; neither changes the FHIR-11014 simple pedigree decision. A 2017 Zulip implementers thread discussed how to read the pedigree extensions and did not identify a conflicting work-group decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already contains the simple genetic FamilyMemberHistory List example with eight contained relatives, current v3 RoleCode system URLs, and example/header references. The remaining To do text in source/list/list-example-familyhistory-genetics-profile.xml is inside an XML comment and is not active example narrative.
